reply.text: {"route": "answer", "say": "Happy to. Set up with the bar over mid-foot, hinge back until you can grip it, then pull your chest up and take the slack out of the bar before you pull. Brace your abs like you're about to take a punch, keep the bar dragging up your legs, and push the floor away rather than yanking with your back. Lock out with your glutes, not by leaning back. Film a set from the side and tell me where it breaks down."}
